style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 60cm Pre Lit Christmas Joy Outdoor Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Want a bountiful, low maintenance wreath? The 60cm Pre Lit Christmas Joy Outdoor Wreath is packed with delight. The pinecones, red leaves, green leaves, red ribbons, and LED lights give the eyes a feast. Create a magical welcome and have a very merry Christmas with the gorgeous pre lit Christmas wreath. The soothing tones of red, green, and brown all give the eyes a relaxing visual interest. The 50 LEDs are dotted around the faux foliage to create a gentle ambience, helping guide you and your family home. Plus, this artificial wreath has the look of a natural wreath without the fuss of shedding needles. Keep the light glowing, with the optional 6-hour timer, which can be programmed to illuminate the LEDs every evening at the same time. There’s also a constant ‘on’ mode. Make your Christmas special with the lush, richly decorated pinecone and beribboned red and green faux foliage wreath.
